title: 第1のつまみ: ゴール前の位置的優位 v1/v2 同条件比較

definitions.same_line_ticket: 買い目の1・2着が、事前の並び予想で同じラインに属すること
definitions.same_line_actual: 実際の1・2着が、事前の並び予想で同じラインに属すること
definitions.composition_correct: 三連単予想3点のいずれかで、1～3着の3人が順不同で一致すること

finding: v2's conditional position-structure model matches winner-member sets more often but over-concentrates on original same-line 1st/2nd ordering (98.4% of tickets vs 64.8% actual outcomes), and does not cover cross-line first-second outcomes or payouts >=10,000 yen.
caveat: Line forecast is not a 4th-turn location; observed historical cohort position may still contain selection bias. Do not interpret rank selection as actual spatial tracking.
next_v3_research_question: Under which structural circumstances do predicted lines persist to final two positions versus split? Model multiple credible space-use scenarios and test ex ante ranking without introducing arbitrary fixed same-line/cross-line quotas; evaluate on a new untouched period.
